verdict.rationale: Lium is a GPU rental platform, and a built-in assistant is a fair capability for such a SaaS product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that the user's own external agents can drive Lium through its CLI, API, MCP server and skill file. Nothing shows an AI assistant built into the product that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
